issues.what: the haze drops from cloud brightness to space in about six pixels, most of it in two or three, so the rim reads as a short step
issues.fix: widen and soften the limb falloff so the glow does not end in a short step

issues.where: south limb of the second frame
issues.what: the same thin rim, with most of the brightness drop inside about four pixels
issues.fix: use the wider, softer falloff of the bright crescent on the darker limb too

issues.what: the moon is softer and slightly glossy beside the sharper cloud deck, so the sphere reads as a wrapped texture
issues.fix: raise the moon texture detail and remove the glossy wrap so it matches the clouds

issues.where: crops D and E, foreground below and to the right of the storm
issues.what: Several neighboring cloud folds curl into similarly smooth, hollow tubes. The illuminated tips retain fine detail, but the broad surfaces between them look smeared and sculpted rather than turbulent.
issues.fix: Vary the size and spacing of the curls and break up the smooth tubes with finer wisps, pockets of density, and overlapping cloud layers.

issues.where: crop Q, mid- to far-distance cloud deck below the blue limb
issues.what: Some dark and blue-gray bands flatten into long, nearly parallel streaks with little crosswise structure, giving the cloud texture a stretched look.
issues.fix: Add intermittent transverse eddies and breaks to the bands while keeping detail progressively finer toward the horizon.

issues.where: crop U, bright blue patch in the dark foreground
issues.what: The brightest blue-white flecks have a soft, diffuse patch around them but little apparent depth or spill onto the adjoining cloud folds, making the glow read as an overlay.
issues.fix: Place the luminous cores within distinct cloud layers and add localized scattering and occlusion around those cores.

issues.where: crop P, moon and adjacent globe
issues.what: The moon's crisp outline contrasts with its soft, mottled illuminated face and nearly solid black shadow, which makes it read slightly like a cutout.
issues.fix: Resolve a little more surface relief on the lit side and soften the transition into shadow without washing out the silhouette.

issues.where: crop S, lower-left dense star field
issues.what: Several bright stars are fuzzy, elongated flecks amid otherwise compact points, and the dense background blends into mottled grain.
issues.fix: Use a consistent, tight star profile and separate unresolved starlight from the larger dust texture.
